Ramkaran vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:112239
Court No
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 22754 of 2023

Applicant :- Ramkaran
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Prabhakar Singh,Bhawesh Pratap Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Prabhakar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
16 of 2023, under Section 376 IPC, Police Station- Khakeru, District- Fatehpur, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged on 20.1.2023 against the applicant and one Shivpoojan and according to the FIR, applicant is the brother-in-law (devar) of the elder sister of the informant/
victim in relation and he sexually exploited the victim under false promise of marriage for about one year and thereafter he refused to perform the marriage with the informant.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that admittedly victim of the case is a major girl aged about 22 years and even from the FIR and from her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C., it is apparent that she was consenting party.

He further submitted that actually victim wanted to perform marriage with the applicant but as applicant is younger than the Ramkaran vs State Of U.P. on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150001944/
1
victim, therefore, his family members were not ready for his marriage, therefore, she lodged the FIR of the present case totally on the basis of false and frivolous facts.
5. Per contra, learned AGA although, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that victim is a major girl and from the record, it appears that she was consenting party.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Although, it is a case of sexual exploitation under the false promise of marriage but from the record it reflects that victim i.e. informant of the case is a major lady aged about 22 years and from the FIR and from her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., it appears that she was consenting party.
8.
Therefore, from the discussion made above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant- Ramkaran be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 22.5.2023
